Sandbox_LMION_Core_GarageMaxLength_toolt: Maximum length allowed for LMION garage door construction and variable placement. Minimum configurable value: 3. Garage doors of length 2 remain supported by LMION variable placement.
Sandbox_LMION_Core_UnlimitedGarageWidth_: Disable LMION's maximum garage door length. When enabled, Maximum Garage Door Length is ignored.
